fishclient.live.new.desc: While the auction runs, every payment you receive counts as a bid. Whoever pays the most wins. You keep the item until you hand it to the winner.
fishclient.live.pick_items: Pick items from your hotbar. Without a pick, the item in your hand is used.
fishclient.live.start_hint: The card shows up on your screen right away.
fishclient.live.need_item: Pick an item or enter a name
fishclient.live.need_seconds: The duration has to be at least 5 seconds
fishclient.live.title: LIVE AUCTION
fishclient.live.refunds_queued: The refunds go out one after another
fishclient.live.hud.desc: The card with timer and bids on your screen
fishclient.live.sum.desc: If someone pays several times, the total counts, otherwise their highest payment
fishclient.live.extend.desc: A bid shortly before the end resets the timer to the minimum time
fishclient.live.extend_seconds: Minimum time after a late bid
fishclient.live.sounds.desc: Sounds at the start, for bids, in the last seconds and at the end
fishclient.live.history.desc: Your live auctions with every bid and open refunds. Redo starts the same auction again.
fishclient.auction.watchlist.desc: Items at or below your price get a green frame in an open auction window. FishClient never buys for you.
fishclient.auction.watch_invalid: Enter a name and a price
fishclient.transactions.desc: Money you got and sent, read from the chat. Check the chat patterns under Settings if nothing shows up.
fishclient.transactions.profit_display.d: Shows the session on screen, red when you are down
fishclient.theme.see_through.desc: Lets the game shine through the panels
fishclient.theme.frosted.desc: Blurs the game behind the menu like frosted glass
fishclient.theme.ambient.desc: Soft, slowly drifting glow behind the menu
fishclient.skins.desc: Switch between saved skins instantly. Only you see the change until you press Apply.
fishclient.skins.empty: Drop a PNG skin onto this window
fishclient.cape.desc: Upload a picture or a 64x32 cape file. For now only you can see it.
fishclient.cape.show.desc: Wear a custom cape on this client
fishclient.cosmetics.desc: Hats and headphones for your character. For now only you can see them.
fishclient.music.now_playing.desc: Shows song, artist and cover as a HUD card
fishclient.music.nothing.desc: Start a song in Spotify, Apple Music or your browser
fishclient.music.how: FishClient reads what Windows reports as currently playing, so it needs no login.
fishclient.music.windows_only: This module only works on Windows.
fishclient.music.lyrics.desc: Loads synced lyrics from lrclib.net, which receives title and artist
fishclient.music.lyrics_not_found: There are no synced lyrics for this song
fishclient.music.lyrics_accent.desc: Tints the floating lines in the theme colour
fishclient.crosshair.dot.desc: Adds a dot in the middle
fishclient.util.freelook.desc: Look around without turning your player
fishclient.util.freelook_third.desc: Moves the camera behind you during freelook
fishclient.util.zoom_scroll.desc: The mouse wheel changes the zoom while it is held
fishclient.util.zoom_click.desc: Plays a spyglass sound when zooming
fishclient.util.fullbright.desc: See in the dark without night vision
fishclient.score.custom.desc: Replaces the look of the server scoreboard
fishclient.score.hide_numbers.desc: Removes the red numbers on the side
fishclient.sky.custom.desc: Shown only on your screen, in the overworld
fishclient.sky.shooting_stars.desc: One crosses the sky every now and then
fishclient.sky.hide_sun.desc: Leaves only the preset in the sky
fishclient.sky.hide_clouds.desc: Bright clouds would stand out against a dark preset
fishclient.portals.desc: The server only sends the world you are in. So FishClient keeps a panorama of both ends of every trip and shows it inside the portal afterwards, like a window. It is a still picture from your last visit, without mobs or players.
fishclient.portals.views.desc: Nether portals show the other side as it was on your last visit
fishclient.portals.transition.desc: Zoom and fade instead of the loading screen when travelling
fishclient.portals.empty: No views on this server yet. Travel through a nether portal once and wait in it for a moment, then both portals show the other side.
fishclient.hud.page_desc: Switch elements on or off. Use Edit HUD at the top to move and scale them.
fishclient.hud.edit_hint: Drag to move · Scroll to scale · Middle-click to reset · Right-click to hide
fishclient.hud.live_auction.desc: Timer, highest bid and every bid
fishclient.hud.top_payer.desc: Who paid you the most this session
fishclient.hud.fps_ping.desc: Frame rate and latency in colour
fishclient.hud.cps.desc: Clicks per second, left and right
fishclient.hud.armor.desc: Armour and held items with durability
fishclient.hud.fishing.desc: Catches and rod, shown while holding a rod
fishclient.hud.minimap.desc: A small map with your waypoints
fishclient.waypoint.world.desc: Markers on screen, visible through walls
fishclient.waypoint.distance.desc: Adds the distance in metres to each marker
fishclient.waypoint.empty: No waypoints in this world yet
fishclient.minimap.show.desc: Small map in a corner of the screen
fishclient.minimap.coords.desc: X, Y and Z below the map
fishclient.minimap.note: The map uses only chunks your client has already loaded.
fishclient.fishing.desc: Catches counted from what your client sees. FishClient never reels in by itself.
fishclient.fishing.bubbles.desc: Bubbles around you while fishing, only for you
fishclient.fishing.rod_skin.desc: Colours fishing lines on your screen
fishclient.fishing.hat_hint: The fish hat is under Cosmetics.
fishclient.screenshot.preview.desc: Shows a small picture for a few seconds
fishclient.screenshot.empty: No screenshots yet. Press F2 in-game.
fishclient.profiles.desc: Each profile keeps its own settings and keybinds. Transactions and waypoints are shared.
fishclient.profiles.import_failed: That file is not a valid profile
fishclient.settings.ui_sounds.desc: Soft sounds for clicks, switches and the menu
fishclient.settings.water_sounds.desc: Bubbles when opening and on the title screen
fishclient.settings.patterns.desc: Regular expressions with the groups player, amount and item. The server is chosen by its address.
